sources.title: Bonsai-8B-gguf Shrinks an 8B Model to Just 1.15 GB - HackerNoon
sources.snippet: Model overview Bonsai-8B-gguf is an 8-billion parameter language model compressed to extreme efficiency through 1-bit quantization. Built on the Qwen3-8B architecture, it achieves a deployed size of just 1.15 GB—14.2 times smaller than the full-precision FP16 version—while maintaining competitive performance across standard benchmarks.

sources.title: Bonsai-8B-gguf: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Bonsai-8B-gguf is an end-to-end 1-bit quantized language model built by prism-ml that runs on llama.cpp across CUDA, Metal, and CPU backends. The model contains 8.19 billion parameters (6.95B non-embedding) and uses a Qwen3-8B dense architecture with grouped-query attention (32 query heads / 8 KV heads), SwiGLU MLP, RoPE positional embeddings, and RMSNorm.
